description: This file contains the implementation of a form renderer class named MacroFormRenderer, which is based on Freemarker macros. It provides methods to render various form fields (like text, checkbox, radio, dropdown, etc.), form structure (open/close), and header/footer elements. The renderer utilizes templates for output and handles complex data interactions, including encoding, tooltips, and JavaScript integration. It is used within a widget framework and appears to be tailored for dynamic form generation within the Apache OFBiz project.

classes.name: MacroFormRenderer
classes.description: A final class implementing the FormStringRenderer interface. This class renders form elements and structures using Freemarker macro templates. It manages form opening, closing, individual field rendering, headers, footers, and layout wrappers, supporting complex interactions such as encoding, tooltips, hyperlinks, and JavaScript integration within the OFBiz framework.
